# TAV-106 — list 500s on concurrent delete ("has no public id")

Worktree: /Users/charlesthomson/git/tavern/.claude/worktrees/agent-a9035559825bb2d1f
Branch: worktree-agent-a9035559825bb2d1f (base ba18948). NO PUSH.

## PLAN
- Root cause: list handlers read rows in one statement, then resolve each row's
  public id (and ref public ids) in separate per-row statements via
  Db::public_id_for (server/db/src/lib.rs:~281), which errors Storage when the
  row is gone. Concurrent DELETE between the two => 500.
- Fix: Db::find_public_id_for -> Option (row gone => None; NULL public_id still
  a storage error). DTO builders become lenient: own id / required (CASCADE)
  parent missing => row skipped from list; nullable (SET NULL) ref missing => null.
- Apply to all list endpoints: chats, characters, character images, personas,
  presets, lorebooks, entries, links, chat members (both), messages.
- Regression tests: delete the row between the page read and DTO build (i.e.
  call the lenient builder with a stale row) per entity + API-level list test.
